subject: Web Development
title: AI in the Browser
description: A micro-lesson that makes AI in the Browser usable.

hook.text: Running AI models used to require powerful servers. Now some run directly in your browser.

buildup.text: TensorFlow.js and ONNX Runtime Web execute machine learning models using WebGPU and Wasm.

discovery.text: Image recognition, language translation, and text generation can happen without any server.

twist.text: Privacy improves dramatically. Your data never leaves your device if the model runs locally.

climax.text: Browser-based AI turns every device with Chrome into a machine learning platform.

punchline.text: AI moved from the cloud to your browser tab.

quiz.question: What benefit does browser-based AI provide?
